def transform(grid):
    points=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (max(set(sum(grid, [])), key=sum(grid, []).count),)]
    # connect the bounding rectangle around all non-background marks
    bg=max(set(sum(grid, [])), key=sum(grid, []).count)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    color=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=color
    return out
